top.line: web-summit.sgit.ai, the one site where six people and their agents ran Web Summit, in four layers.
top.para: Built from markdown and data in git, 6,096 commits. People: briefs, levels L0 to L6, a command centre each. Agents: 108 keys, an inbox lane each, secrets sealed to keys. Work: 219 board items. The world outside: 110 companies, the X-ray, a public and private CRM.

in-short.line: One site, people, agents, work, the world outside, and the series.
in-short.para: Article two of Ten days at Web Summit.

site.line: A website built from a git repository, every push a release: 6,096 commits since 28 October.
site.para: The site's rule: a thing not in its REALITY file does not exist.

people.line: A brief, a prompt, levels L0 to L6, and a command centre for each person.
people.para: One engine for every command centre, made calmer on 7 November.

agents.line: Agents named for their person, 108 public keys, secrets sealed to keys, an inbox lane per agent.
agents.para: On 9 November: keys for every device and version, QR and NFC exchange, signing as a graph, partly built.

work.line: The board as 219 files: 34 done, 6 in progress, 54 picked, 124 open.
work.para: Briefs kept close to the words; one clone gives an agent the team's whole state.

outside.line: 110 companies on a map, the RiskMandate X-ray, and a CRM in public and private vaults.
outside.para: Eleven X-ray test searches cost about 0.94 dollars, API-equivalent.

lessons.line: One site for people and agents, keys first, files over dashboards, and keep the reality file current.
lessons.para: The REALITY file fell behind in the busiest days.

limits.line: Figures from the repository on 14 November; dollars API-equivalent; some features proposals.
limits.para: Device keys, NFC and signing as a graph only partly built.

sources.line: The web-summit.sgit.ai repository and pages, and earlier newsroom articles.
